en: A black and white photograph showing a rustic stone-and-wood house nestled in a lush forest setting. The house, labeled as 'Haus Abendfrieden,' features shuttered windows and a steep roof, surrounded by birch and conifer trees. The scene conveys tranquility and rural charm typical of central European forests. There is printed text at the bottom identifying the location as 'Schellerhau/Erzgeb. - Haus Abendfrieden.'
